description: Photos and videos: albums, search, people
agentGuide: Base path /api. Albums: GET /api/albums; one with its assets: GET /api/albums/<id>; create: POST /api/albums {"albumName": "...", "assetIds": [...]}. Search: POST /api/search/metadata {"takenAfter": "2026-01-01", "city": "Lyon", "size": 50} or POST /api/search/smart {"query": "beach sunset"} (CLIP). An asset: GET /api/assets/<id>; its picture: GET /api/assets/<id>/thumbnail?size=preview (binary). People: GET /api/people; stats: GET /api/server/statistics. Timeline buckets: GET /api/timeline/buckets?size=MONTH. The key is set by Allkin.
